instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope
prompt:
Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a luxurious decorative envelope as the main subject, centered in the foreground and designed as a premium invitation inspired by the character Skye. The envelope should feel handcrafted, elegant and refined, with realistic paper texture, soft matte finish, subtle fibers, and sophisticated metallic accents in rose gold, silver and polished pink. The design may include delicate folds, precise geometry, and ornamental details such as a wax seal, ribbon, emblem, or embossed closure, all finely detailed and tactile. The overall aesthetic should evoke Skye’s energetic, adventurous and airy personality through graceful aviation-inspired motifs, soft cloud-like forms, subtle wing-shaped ornaments, star-like sparkles, and sleek modern elegance, without referencing any franchise directly.

The envelope is placed within a rich, story-driven environment, not a flat backdrop. The background forms a dreamy narrative scene with soft-focus elements that suggest a magical sky-inspired setting: floating clouds, glowing light particles, gentle aerial motion, and elegant decorative accents in pink and metallic tones. The environment should feel premium and enchanting, with depth and context while keeping the envelope as the clear hero. Surrounding elements are carefully curated and symbolic, including petals, sparkles, floating dust, luminous bokeh, and airy decorative shapes arranged organically around the envelope, enhancing motion and charm without overpowering the composition.

Lighting is cinematic and dramatic, with a soft key light illuminating the envelope, delicate rim light outlining its edges, and volumetric light rays streaming from above or behind. Subtle mist, atmospheric haze, and floating particles catch the light, creating a dreamy, magical, and luxurious mood. Shadows are soft, realistic, and directional. The color palette is intentional and harmonious, dominated by tones of pink and metal: blush pink, rose gold, champagne silver, soft magenta, pearlescent highlights, and warm luminous reflections, with smooth gradients and controlled contrast.

Composition: foreground-focused, envelope sharply in focus, background softly defocused, strong sense of depth and perspective. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on envelope texture, seal, and ornaments, cinematic bokeh in background lights. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic fantasy realism, elegant, magical, premium invitation aesthetic. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, luxurious, visually enchanting, suitable for premium invitations and storytelling visuals.
folhaInstruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de de uma folha em branco com adornos em torno, sendo essa folha o objeto central e principal da imagem, ocupando quase a tela toda, mas ainda deixando espaço para visualizar o chão, o fundo e os elementos laterais
folhaPrompt:
Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a **blank decorative sheet of paper** as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying nearly the entire frame, with the sheet dominating the scene while still leaving enough visible space around it to reveal the floor, background, and side elements. The paper feels handcrafted, premium and refined, with realistic paper texture, soft matte surface, subtle fibers, clean edges, and elegant ornamental details in rose-toned and metallic finishes. The sheet is pristine, empty, and central, designed as a luxurious visual canvas, with delicate adornments framing it organically around the borders without covering the blank center. Ornamental elements include thin metallic filigree, soft rose petals, elegant floral accents, shimmering dust, subtle ribbons, and refined decorative motifs inspired by the theme **Skye**, evoking a dreamy, airy, celestial atmosphere with graceful, light, elevated visual symbolism.  

The sheet is placed within a rich, story-driven environment, not a flat backdrop. The background forms a narrative scene — ethereal, sky-inspired, elegant and softly magical — with recognizable depth and context, while remaining softly blurred so the blank sheet stays the clear hero. The visible floor adds realism and grounding, with tasteful reflections or soft textures, and the side elements frame the composition with symmetry and sophistication. Surrounding details are carefully curated and symbolic, including floating petals, gentle sparkles, metallic accents, soft luminous particles, and airy decorative forms that suggest movement and grace without overpowering the composition. These elements feel natural, suspended gently in space, enhancing elegance and visual rhythm.  

Lighting is cinematic and dramatic, with a soft key light illuminating the blank sheet, delicate rim light outlining its edges, and subtle volumetric light rays streaming from above or behind. The atmosphere includes a faint mist, luminous haze, and floating particles that catch the light, creating a dreamy, premium mood. Shadows are soft, realistic, and directional. The color palette is intentional and harmonious, dominated by **tones of pink and metal**, including blush pink, rose gold, champagne metallic, soft silver, and pearl highlights, with smooth gradients, luminous reflections, and controlled contrast.  

Composition: foreground-focused, blank sheet sharply in focus, decorative adornments framing it, background softly defocused, strong sense of depth and perspective, with visible floor and lateral space preserved. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on paper texture and ornamental edges, cinematic bokeh in background lights. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic fantasy realism, elegant, airy, premium stationery aesthetic, inspired by the theme **Skye**. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, luxurious, visually enchanting, suitable for premium stationery, elegant branding and storytelling visuals.
cartaoPrompt: Gere um cartão na horizontal elegante nessa mesma atmosfera e mesmo tema (Skye) e mesma paleta de cor (Tons de Rosa e metal), escrito apenas Alice, idade 10 Anos.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
A animação começa focando em um envelope fechado com um único selo de cera. Assim que o selo de cera se desprende fisicamente e cai no chão, ele não é substituído, duplicado nem regenerado em momento algum. O envelope permanece permanentemente aberto após esse instante, sem que surja qualquer outro selo.
Uma vez removido o selo, a aba do envelope se levanta lentamente. De seu interior, emergem brilhos cintilantes, poeira brilhante e rastros de luz radiante, espalhando-se pelo ambiente em um espetáculo hipnotizante, com feixes mágicos de partículas luminosas que se curvam em torno do envelope, passando à sua frente e por trás em um movimento contínuo. Essas partículas originam-se apenas de dentro do envelope, aumentando em densidade e luminosidade à medida que se deslocam.
A luz radiante se intensifica e se expande para fora, preenchendo gradualmente toda a cena. Nenhum novo objeto físico é introduzido durante essa transição. O brilho intenso dos feixes e das partículas transforma-se em uma tela branca sólida e deslumbrante no quadro final. A câmera aplica um zoom sutil e lento.
